verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly offer an API or bulk-filing interface for unattended automation, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only interactive, OHID-authenticated web portals (Gateway, OH|TAX). Probes show both ohiosos.gov and the Ohio Business Central filing portal returning HTTP 403 even at robots.txt. Nothing documents a headless, CLI, API, or CI-friendly mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
